name: Stickman Video Editing Studio
description: Autonomous Stickman Video Director & Production Engine (Stick Story): Make narrated stick figure YouTube Shorts / TikToks / Reels fully in code: free local AI voice (Kokoro), Whisper word-synced captions, animated stick figures with acting eyes, day/night rooms, gold step cards, sound and music, rendered to MP4. Anti-LMK Shield, High-Speed Render Presets (--fast, --turbo, --1080p). No API keys, no credits.
author: Dipesh Kr Yadav
